name.title: ZIM Name
name.description: Identifier and filename stem. Library convention is <project>_<lang>_<flavour>

title.title: ZIM Title
title.description: Title for the ZIM, up to 30 characters

long_description.title: ZIM Long Description
long_description.description: Long description (up to 4000 chars) for ZIM

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO-639-3 (3 chars) language code of content

tags.title: ZIM Tags
tags.description: List of semi-colon-separated Tags for the ZIM file

base_url.title: Serving prefix
base_url.description: URL prefix the book is mounted under; passed to the Docusaurus build as DOCS_BASE_URL

only_current_version.title: Current docs only
only_current_version.description: Exclude archived documentation versions from the build

exclude.title: Exclusions
exclude.description: Comma-separated glob patterns; matching built files are never added to the ZIM

prune_prefixes.title: Prune prefixes
prune_prefixes.description: Comma-separated built subtrees reduced to only their referenced files

index_selector.title: Index selector
index_selector.description: CSS selector whose text is indexed for each HTML page; empty indexes the whole page

mirror_hosts.title: Mirror hosts
mirror_hosts.description: Comma-separated hosts whose images are copied into the ZIM

asset_prefixes.title: Asset prefixes
asset_prefixes.description: Comma-separated root-absolute asset prefixes re-pointed at baseUrl
